name: unsafe fn from_raw_socket (sock : RawSocket) -> Self
rule: The sock passed to from_raw_socket must be a socket that may be freed via closesocket.
api: trait FromRawSocket  : { unsafe fn from_raw_socket (sock : std::os::windows::io::raw::RawSocket) -> Self }
expression: The requirement cannot be expressed in the supplied DSL: it provides no predicate for whether a socket may be freed via closesocket.
